translations.explanation:
Learning goal: You will a Towering Sequence.
The purpose of this lesson is for you to work with sequences and describe them recursively in an informal way. A sequence is defined here as a list of numbers while a term (of a sequence) is one of the numbers in the list. Using the Tower of Hanoi puzzle, you first make sense of the rules of the puzzle before playing with different numbers of discs in order to generate a sequence representing the minimum number of moves needed to complete the puzzle (MP1).
